identity_rule: Independent design/characterization provenance; never proximity to published state or angles.

fields.name: apparatus_epoch_and_collection_reference_plane
fields.needed_for: Same source, filters, couplers, detector plane and date across all calibrations.

fields.name: pump_to_r_src_and_relative_phase
fields.needed_for: Absolute path excitation, source profile normalization and preparation map, including stability across preparation.

fields.name: source_complex_joint_mode_amplitudes_and_local_optics
fields.needed_for: Raw producer inputs F_H/F_V and local collection transfer, including lost ports; sufficient-statistic calibration is an alternative for identifying output family, not unique microscopic source recovery.

fields.name: six_collection_powers
fields.needed_for: Separate pure-path source calibration, absolute normalization and partner-lost sectors.

fields.name: two_overlap_quadratures
fields.needed_for: Known-phase coherent preparation and two independent interference quadratures; no arbitrary visibility-to-channel conversion.

fields.name: absolute_postcollection_uA_uB
fields.needed_for: Separate detector/transmission efficiency from conditional Klyshko efficiency, with wavelength/polarization/settings dependencies tested.

fields.name: Q1_Qmultipair_and_repetition_rate_vs_preparation
fields.needed_for: Per-pulse exactly-one-pair, multiple-pair distribution or gain/mode Hamiltonian, repetition frequency; distinguishes source Q, QPp, q_eff, HH epsilon squared and mean pair number.

fields.name: calibration_preparation_invariance_and_uncertainty
fields.needed_for: Independent second-preparation validation of fixed profiles/optics and covariance of inferred moments; constant pump power alone is insufficient.

fields.name: analyzer_coordinate_and_loss_maps
fields.needed_for: Polarizer/HWP angle convention, physical source branch labels, phase, setting-dependent loss and evidence for polarization-preserving S3.

fields.name: background_window_detector_and_multipair_model
fields.needed_for: Accidentals/dark subtraction for Klyshko calibration; intended additive-vs-OR detector and finite-window/dead-time treatment for pulse predictions.

forbidden_substitutes: merging historical and published configuration identities
